migration_metadata.description: Present only on documents migrated from an older result schema.

threads.description: Instance worker threads; zero selects an automatic bounded value.

memory_budget_mb.description: Conservative peak-memory budget in MiB; zero derives a safe automatic budget from currently available physical/container memory.

control_variate.description: Compute the two-nearest-neighbor control variate and fixed-subset bound; the bound measures tour quality conditional on that subset.

cv_mc_samples.description: Cheap KNN-only samples used to estimate the full-set control-variate expectation.

held_karp.description: Compute the Held-Karp lower bound for each selected subset; this certifies tour quality conditional on that subset, not global subset optimality.

include_instance_rows.description: Include per-instance rows and restart diagnostics in JSON.

fidelity_level.description: Fidelity identity such as cheap or strong.

second_sweep.description: Run an ascending continuation sweep after the descending sweep.

dry_run.description: Validate and print the resolved configuration without solving.

dump_config.description: Print the resolved configuration before solving.

output_durability.description: Output durability: none, file, or full (file plus parent directory).

knn_k.description: Exact KNN candidate count; values are capped to N-1.

knn_backend.description: Exact KNN backend: grid or bruteforce.

reverse_knn.description: Build reverse-KNN adjacency lazily when candidate local search needs it; disable to save additional memory.

grid_cell.description: Force a grid cell size; zero selects an automatic safe value.

exact_subset_max_n.description: Globally solve subset choice and tour when N is at most this threshold; zero disables it.

tsp_candidate_starts.description: Cheap deterministic TSP starts screened before ILS promotion.

tsp_farthest_starts.description: Opt into at most one cubic farthest-insertion pilot.

tsp_min_edge_jaccard.description: Preferred edge-Jaccard distance among promoted TSP starts.

tsp_restarts.description: Full TSP restarts promoted into ILS.

search_policy_preset.description: Search controller preset. legacy-balanced preserves the 0.10 controller. heldout-balanced uses the held-out four-candidate SA policy through p=0.35; heldout-quality uses a deeper policy, extends periodic runs through p=0.50, and strengthens full-TSP screening. Explicit core SA or TSP population controls take precedence.

subset_restarts.description: Subset restarts; -1 selects the p-aware automatic policy.

continuation_restarts.description: Warm restarts when a neighboring-p parent exists.

racing_candidates.description: Supplemental candidates screened by deterministic restart racing; zero disables it.

racing_survivors.description: Pilot candidates promoted to a full-depth rerun.

racing_pilot_iters.description: SA iterations used to screen each race candidate.

racing_min_jaccard.description: Preferred selected-set Jaccard distance between promoted race candidates.

staged_search.description: Reserve expensive post-SA neighborhoods for promoted finalists.

strong_polish_finalists.description: Finalists receiving the strong search stage.

strong_polish_min_jaccard.description: Preferred selected-set distance among strong-polish finalists.

sa_iters_per_k.description: Additional SA iterations per selected node k.

sa_iters_per_n.description: Additional SA iterations per candidate point N.

sa_exact_insertion.description: Use the historical exact O(k) insertion scan for every SA move.

sa_insertion_window.description: Tour-position radius for windowed SA insertion.

small_p_dense_fill.description: At small p, fill the restart pool with dense-seed variants instead of uncontracted random subsets.

exploration_exact_insertion.description: Use exact insertion for spread-out exploration seeds.

sa_spatial_insertion.description: Use insertion slots from a live spatial index (default: false).

dense_exact_insertion.description: Force exact insertion on dense seeds; this reproduces the old bit-identical path at k=2000 but costs about +58% wall.

sa_spatial_neighbors.description: Nearest current members allowed to offer insertion slots.

region_seeds.description: Use localized region seeds in the explorer pool.

kick_fraction.description: Fraction of members swapped by an elite kick.

kick_t0.description: SA start temperature for elite-kick restarts.

sa_auto_temperature.description: Calibrate each restart's SA temperatures from sampled uphill move deltas.

sa_temperature_samples.description: Target positive-delta samples for restart-local SA calibration.

sa_temperature_quantile.description: Positive-delta quantile used to calibrate SA endpoints.

sa_initial_uphill_acceptance.description: Target initial acceptance for the calibrated uphill-delta quantile.

sa_final_uphill_acceptance.description: Target final acceptance for the calibrated uphill-delta quantile.

sa_candidate_trials.description: Candidate swaps evaluated per SA iteration; one preserves the historical proposal.

sa_multiple_try_random_probability.description: For multiple-try SA, probability of selecting a random valid trial instead of the best.

restart_threads.description: Parallel subset-restart workers; zero requests automatic allocation.

time_budget_per_p.description: Wall-clock target per instance/p solve; zero disables anytime mode.

exhaustive_two_opt_policy.description: Exhaustive 2-opt policy: never, final-only, or all-polish.

pair_exchange_max_k.description: Skip pair exchange above k; zero removes the gate.

adaptive_ruin_recreate.description: Use the adaptive multi-scale ruin/recreate operator portfolio.

ruin_recreate_max_nodes.description: Absolute ruin-size cap; zero removes it.

ejection_chain_depth.description: Maximum membership swaps per ejection chain.

ejection_chain_remove_cap.description: Removable selected-node cap per chain step; zero means all.

ejection_chain_max_uphill.description: Maximum cumulative uphill excursion in mean-edge units.

elite_min_jaccard.description: Minimum selected-set Jaccard distance for supplemental elite entries.

elite_quality_slack.description: Quality slack allowed for supplemental diverse entries.

path_relink_top.description: Literal maximum archive population exposed to relinking.

path_relink_diverse_reserve.description: Diversity-preferred entries inside the relinking node cap.

path_relink_max_pairs.description: Maximum ranked relinking pair attempts; zero is unlimited.

path_relink_max_removed.description: Maximum one-way selected-set difference per pair; zero is unlimited.

path_relink_max_removed_sum.description: Cumulative selected-set-difference budget; zero is unlimited.

path_relink_max_candidate_scans.description: Exact relinking candidate-scan budget; zero is unlimited.

mode.description: Solver mode: balanced, smallp-region, highp-delete, or hybrid.

disable_highp_delete.description: Disable high-p deletion seeds and exchange.

oracle_mode.description: External oracle: none, auto, lkh, or concorde.

oracle_format.description: Oracle problem format: matrix or euc2d.

oracle_time_limit_sec.description: Per-call oracle time limit; zero disables it.

oracle_scale.description: Distance scaling factor for integer oracle matrices.

oracle_tsp_top.description: Top full-TSP solutions sent to the oracle.

oracle_subset_top.description: Top subset solutions sent to the oracle.

oracle_min_k.description: Minimum cardinality eligible for an external oracle.

oracle_max_k.description: Maximum cardinality eligible for an external oracle.

oracle_lkh_max_trials.description: LKH MAX_TRIALS; zero uses the solver default.

oracle_use_for_tsp.description: Disable external-oracle use for full TSP.

oracle_use_for_subset.description: Disable external-oracle use for subset tours.

oracle_inline_feedback.description: Feed oracle-improved cycles back into the in-process elite search.

oracle_exec_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the resolved oracle executable, or unknown when it could not be read.

region_restarts.description: Executed subset restarts whose final kind is region.

dense_restarts.description: Executed subset restarts whose final kind is dense.

racing_pilot_restarts.description: Unique raced candidates that received the fixed screening pilot.

racing_promoted_restarts.description: Raced candidates promoted to a full-depth rerun after screening.

strong_polish_candidates.description: Eligible post-SA restart candidates considered by the staged strong-search funnel.

strong_polish_finalists.description: Candidates promoted to subset swap, pair exchange, ruin/recreate, ejection-chain, and inline-oracle stages.

strong_polish_improvements.description: Strong-polish finalists whose recorded restart length strictly improved.

elite_diversity_candidates.description: Unique candidates considered by the supplemental diversity archive.

elite_diversity_retained.description: Considered candidates retained in either the protected quality archive or a diverse slot.

elite_diversity_rejected.description: Considered candidates rejected from the bounded quality-plus-diversity archive.

sa_candidate_evaluations.description: Valid candidate swap evaluations performed by the SA proposal controller.

sa_multiple_try_iterations.description: SA iterations that used more than one candidate trial.

sa_temperature_schedules.description: Restart schedules with at least one allocated SA iteration.

sa_temperature_calibrations.description: Restart schedules successfully calibrated from sampled uphill deltas.

sa_temperature_fallbacks.description: Requested restart calibrations that safely fell back to fixed endpoints.

sa_decile_moves.description: Valid SA moves by temperature-schedule decile.

sa_decile_uphill_moves.description: Uphill SA moves by temperature-schedule decile.

sa_decile_accepted.description: Accepted SA moves by temperature-schedule decile.

sa_decile_uphill_accepted.description: Accepted uphill SA moves by temperature-schedule decile.

ejection_chain_accepted_depth.description: Sum of accepted improving prefix depths across completed searches.

exec_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the executable used for this call, or unknown when it could not be read.

solver_version.description: Version probe captured when the oracle context was resolved.

exact_optimal_instances.description: Number of instances globally proven optimal by the exact subset oracle.

subset_bound_mean.description: Deprecated schema-13 alias of conditional_two_nn_bound_mean. This bounds only the optimal tour through each selected subset, not the optimum over all size-k subsets.

conditional_two_nn_bound_mean.description: Mean two-nearest-neighbor lower bound, divided by k, on the tour through the subset selected by the heuristic. It is conditional on that subset and is not a global lower bound on the optimum over all size-k subsets.

conditional_two_nn_gap_mean.description: Mean tour value minus conditional_two_nn_bound_mean. This diagnoses fixed-subset tour ordering and bound looseness, not subset-selection error.

conditional_held_karp_bound_mean.description: Mean Held-Karp lower bound, divided by k, on the optimal tour through the subset selected by the heuristic. It is not a bound on the optimum over all size-k subsets.

conditional_held_karp_gap_mean.description: Mean tour value minus conditional_held_karp_bound_mean. A small value certifies tour-ordering quality for the selected subsets only.

exact_optimal_instances.description: Number of instances globally proven optimal by the exact subset oracle.

conditional_two_nn_bound.description: Two-nearest-neighbor lower bound divided by k for the tour through this selected subset; conditional on the subset.

conditional_held_karp_bound.description: Held-Karp lower bound divided by k for the tour through this selected subset; conditional on the subset.

restart_kinds.description: Stable restart-kind codes defined by include/aldous_tsp/restart_kinds.def.

restart_sweeps.description: Sweep per restart: 0=primary (descending or standalone), 1=secondary (ascending second sweep).

restart_roles.description: Search-controller role per restart: 0=independent diagnostic, 1=continuation, 2=elite kick, 3=anytime, 4=raced production.

restart_variants.description: Stable zero-based seed variant within each restart kind and role.

restart_sa_iterations.description: Actual SA iterations allocated to each recorded candidate. Promoted race entries include pilot plus full-depth rerun work.

restart_sa_t0.description: Actual initial SA temperature used by each recorded restart; zero when that restart performed no SA.

restart_sa_t1.description: Actual final SA temperature used by each recorded restart; zero when that restart performed no SA.

restart_sa_temperature_samples.description: Positive-delta calibration samples collected for each recorded restart.

restart_sa_temperature_calibrated.description: Whether each recorded restart used calibrated rather than fixed SA endpoints.

restart_strong_polished.description: Whether each recorded restart received the strong finalist neighborhood stage.

restart_centroids_x.description: Toroidal centroid x of each restart's subset.

restart_centroids_y.description: Toroidal centroid y of each restart's subset.

restart_radii.description: Mean distance of subset members to their centroid.

exact_optimal.description: True only when the global cardinality-k subset choice and its cycle were solved exactly.

phase_timing.description: Accumulated worker elapsed-seconds by solver phase. Nested SA checkpoint timing is included in sa_seconds and should not be added as a disjoint phase. Proposal/insertion sample durations are raw deterministic 1-in-64 timing samples.

exact_subset_seconds.description: Elapsed worker-seconds spent in the global exact subset-tour dynamic program.
